skills.name: fix-seo
skills.description: Fix the SEO problem Loomaly ranks first on a site, in this repository: get the fix-first queue, read the evidence and fix prompt, change the code on a branch, mark it fixed with the PR link, and re-check it once it's deployed.
skills.description_zh: 在仓库修复Loomaly排首位的SEO问题，读取优先队列、证据与修复提示，在分支修改代码，以PR链接标记已修复，并在部署后复查。

skills.name: internal-links
skills.description: Add the internal links Loomaly suggests: review each suggestion with the user, add the approved ones to the source content in this repository, and record each decision.
skills.description_zh: 逐项与用户评审Loomaly建议的内部链接，将批准的链接加入仓库源内容并记录每项决定。

skills.name: site-health
skills.description: Explain a site's SEO health from Loomaly in plain language: the score, what it's made of, and the few problems worth fixing first, with how many pages each affects.
skills.description_zh: 用通俗语言解释Loomaly网站SEO健康评分、构成、优先修复问题及各问题影响的页面数。

skills.name: weekly-loop
skills.description: Run the weekly SEO loop on one page that should make money: read how the focus page did, judge the last change by search and conversions, and propose one next change with evidence. Use when the user asks what to work on this week, whether a change worked, or wants a weekly SEO check-in.
headings: The weekly loop on the focus page
skills.description_zh: 对预期带来收入的重点页面进行每周SEO复盘，读取表现、按搜索与转化评估上次改动，并依据证据提出下一项改动。
